source: The fix-it plan's S7 (~/Documents/nmas-reports/fix-it-ai-build-plan.md, the cases table), its eight recorded cases. Each pack is captured from the host by `scripts/nmas-fixit-cases --capture` (the request Mercury builds for the incident, `fixit_troubleshoot.snapshot`), never typed; its addresses moved to the documentation ranges for the publication scan, and nothing else edited. A case's note is its own words, stated here. Until a pack is captured the case is not ready (`--check`), and nothing is asked.
bar: PHASE8_PLAN 15.12: each recorded case reliable at 10 runs, none confidently wrong; the blind set (blind.json) at a floor of 85%.
